title: AI product docs hotline: answers taken from your documentation or a refusal, never a guess
summary: A product docs hotline demo built to show a voice AI agent grounded by its tool rather than its prompt. A similarity gate drops weak search results before the model sees them, so an off-topic question gets a refusal.
scenario: A caller asks how the product works and hears an answer from a local search index of the docs, or "That's not in the docs"
